node.title: Re: Why this script is not running on windows?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [abhikalrt53],

Why not turn it into a real script?

$ perl -MO=Deparse -ane '$s = ""; foreach (@F) { /(\d+)-(\d+)/ and $2 - $1 >= 30 and $s .= " $1-$2" } print "$F[0]$s\n" if $s' LINE: while (defined($_ = )) { our @F = split(' ', $_, 0); $s = ''; foreach $_ (@F) { $s .= " $1-$2" if /(\d+)-(\d+)/ and $2 - $1 >= 30; } print "$F[0]$s\n" if $s; }

With a bit of cleanup:

#!/usr/bin/env perl use warnings; use strict; while (<>) { my @fields = split; my $s = ''; for (@fields) { if ( /(\d+)-(\d+)/ && $2 - $1 >= 30 ) { $s .= " $1-$2"; } } print "$fields[0]$s\n" if $s; }

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
